origin_definitions.primary_method: The research dimension directly implements one or more claims supported by the methodology source ledger. Concrete metrics remain Seed's operationalization.
origin_definitions.mixed: A primary-source method claim determines the question or gate, while Seed adds evidence, accounting or process controls needed for repeatable company research.
origin_definitions.seed_operating_control: Seed added the dimension to prevent evidence loss or false inference. It may provide context for a method claim but must not be attributed to Buffett or Munger.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: A share is an ownership interest, but exact issuer, share class, rights, currency and listing identity are Seed source-integrity controls.
required_checks: Resolve exact security, legal issuer, share class and rights.
Bind price, share count, currency and listing status to dated primary evidence.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: The ownership orientation is primary-source method; the security-master and legal-identity protocol is Seed engineering.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed translates incentives, candor and capital stewardship into an auditable controller, related-party and minority-interest map.
required_checks: Identify controller, voting arrangements, pledges and cross-holdings.
Trace value transfers, NCI and related-party exposures.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Primary sources support incentive and stewardship questions; the beneficial-ownership evidence graph is a Seed control.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed requires a falsifiable customer-to-cash explanation rather than a descriptive company summary.
required_checks: Explain who pays, why they pay and how revenue becomes cash.
Name the capital needs and variables that would invalidate the explanation.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Understanding and predictability are primary method; the customer-to-cash template is Seed operationalization.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Primary filings must separate product, segment, geography, volume, price, organic and acquired growth before long-term economics can be interpreted.
required_checks: Reconcile reported revenue by segment, product and geography.
Separate volume, price, mix, acquisition and accounting-scope effects.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: The detailed revenue bridge is a Seed evidence control, not a Buffett/Munger checklist item.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed maps where pricing power, inventory, credit and reinvestment risk sit so industry growth is not mistaken for shareholder value.
required_checks: Map upstream inputs, core process, direct customers, end payer and substitutes.
Identify who captures the profit pool and who bears inventory, credit and technology risk.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Industry growth versus shareholder economics is primary method; the value-chain graph is Seed operationalization.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed requires price, volume, contribution economics, retention or utilization evidence appropriate to the industry.
required_checks: Measure price, volume, mix and incremental economics at the most decision-useful grain.
State industry-specific denominator, scope and comparability limits.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Favorable long-term economics is primary method; the unit-economics measurement contract is Seed engineering.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Customer concentration, behavior, receivables and end demand are mandatory evidence for understanding a business and testing a moat.
required_checks: Separate direct customer, channel, end user and payer.
Test concentration, retention, receivables, channel inventory and independent customer evidence.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Mandatory customer evidence is a Seed control; it supports but is not itself a quoted Buffett/Munger rule.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Supply concentration, substitution, prepayments and cost pass-through can invalidate apparent economics or resilience.
required_checks: Identify critical inputs, concentration, related parties and substitution time.
Test procurement terms, prepayments, availability and cost pass-through.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Mandatory supplier evidence is a Seed control, not an attributed Buffett/Munger checklist.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed turns the moat question into competitor, capacity, price, entry, exit and substitution tests.
required_checks: Measure entry, exit, capacity, price and substitution behavior.
Compare company claims with competitor, customer and regulator evidence.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Durable competition protection is primary method; the market-structure test battery is Seed operationalization.

required_checks: Name the mechanism, visible economic result, durability and direction of change.
Preserve the strongest evidence that would falsify the moat.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Moat, quality and direction are primary method; specific indicator thresholds are not.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed checks whether recognized revenue converts to collectible cash and whether accounting timing obscures economics.
required_checks: Compare revenue growth with receivables, contract assets, returns and cash collection.
Identify acquisition, quarter-end, channel or recognition distortions.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Revenue-quality diagnostics are Seed accounting controls that support owner-economics analysis.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed reconciles parent-attributable profit, non-operating items, estimates and scope before using earnings economically.
required_checks: Bridge reported parent earnings to a defensible normalized range.
Preserve tax, attribution, accounting-scope and adjustment disagreements.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Owner earnings is primary method; the reported-to-normalized accounting bridge is Seed operationalization.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed separates operating cash, financing effects, restricted cash and industry-specific cash-flow distortion.
required_checks: Reconcile profit, operating cash and distributable cash across periods.
Identify factoring, delayed payments, restricted cash and financial-sector scope distortions.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Cash economics is part of owner earnings; detailed cash-flow diagnostics are Seed controls.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed measures the incremental working capital needed to sustain normal operations and growth.
required_checks: Track receivables, inventory, payables, prepayments and contract balances.
Separate sustainable operating financing from temporary cash release.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Required incremental working capital follows owner-economics logic; the detailed schedule is Seed engineering.

required_checks: Separate maintenance from growth investment using a transparent range.
Relate capex, capacity, utilization and competitive requirements.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Capital required to maintain competitive position is primary method; estimation techniques are Seed operationalization.

required_checks: Reproduce multi-period ROE, ROIC and incremental returns with scope and formula.
Separate leverage, buybacks, cyclicality and accounting changes from operating returns.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Returns on capital over cosmetic EPS growth is primary method; exact ratio formulas are Seed controls.

required_checks: Test debt maturity, liquidity, covenants, guarantees, pledges and off-balance-sheet obligations.
Describe financing needs under an adverse but plausible operating scenario.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Avoiding leverage-driven ruin and preserving uncertainty are primary method; stress design is Seed operationalization.

required_checks: Track reinvestment, acquisitions, dividends, repurchases, issuance, debt and idle cash.
Judge outcomes per diluted share and against alternative uses of capital.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Capital allocation and price-sensitive repurchases are primary method; the historical ledger is Seed engineering.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed tests claims against outcomes, incentives, compensation, succession and regulatory records rather than tone.
required_checks: Compare dated management commitments with subsequent outcomes.
Evaluate incentives, compensation, succession, insider actions and candor.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Candor, incentives and institutional behavior are method context; the commitment ledger is a Seed control.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed makes minority treatment, related transactions, guarantees and board dissent explicit failure tests.
required_checks: Trace related sales, purchases, loans, guarantees and asset transfers.
Test pricing basis, minority fairness, audit oversight and dissent.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Incentive and stewardship principles motivate the question; the governance checklist is Seed operationalization.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Audit opinion, accounting policy, restatements and primary-statement reproduction are required before economic interpretation.
required_checks: Record audit opinion, key audit matters, standard, policy changes and restatements.
Reproduce material statement facts and preserve conflicts.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: The accounting-integrity gate is Seed engineering; it protects but is not attributed as a Buffett/Munger checklist.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Unrecorded tax, litigation, environmental, data or regulatory liabilities can create permanent capital loss.
required_checks: Reconcile effective tax, deferred tax and material uncertain positions.
Record litigation, penalties, compliance obligations and plausible tail exposure.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Detailed tax and legal review is a Seed survival control, not a direct Buffett/Munger claim.

required_checks: Reconcile basic, diluted and fully diluted share counts across dates.
Translate growth, distributions, issuance and repurchases into per-share outcomes.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Per-share intrinsic value is primary method; dilution reconciliation is Seed engineering.

required_checks: Produce a currency-consistent value range with explicit assumptions and dates.
Run reverse expectations, sensitivities and at least one suitable cross-check.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Price versus intrinsic value and quality-aware selection are primary method; DCF fields and scenario shapes are Seed implementation.

dimensions.seed_control_rationale: Seed implements inversion and bias resistance through an independent red-team artifact and observable invalidation tests.
required_checks: State the strongest counter-thesis before merging the main conclusion.
Record observable invalidation conditions, next evidence and review date.
dimensions.attribution_boundary: Inversion, learning and incentive awareness are method context; the independent red-team stage is Seed engineering.
